subject.title: fix(doctor): persist safe migrations before runtime timeouts

question: Does the intended upgrade contract permit Doctor to durably persist a validated migration result before runtime-backed diagnostics, while still returning the later timeout as a nonzero result?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive ordering choice for existing configurations, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit maintainer handling even though the supplied proof supports the behavior.

options.title: Approve the durable migration boundary
options.body: Accept the proposed behavior: valid config-flow migrations persist before unrelated runtime diagnostics, while later failures still return their original error.

options.title: Keep all writes after diagnostics
options.body: Reject the sequencing change and instead pursue a narrower change that makes the prepared-runtime timeout nonfatal or otherwise isolates that diagnostic.

recommendation.title: Approve the durable migration boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed behavior: valid config-flow migrations persist before unrelated runtime diagnostics, while later failures still return their original error.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked report supplies the concrete reproduction and describes the intended Doctor upgrade contract that this PR changes.
